title: The dashboard shell renders the five required regions on every shipped surface
asA: product owner responsible for the shipped dashboard surface
iWant: the shell to render a tile row, a chart region, filter chrome, a timeframe picker and an export handle on every dashboard surface
soThat: every REQ, TAC and pack check on this blueprint anchors onto a stable, inspectable shell structure rather than a floating layout convention

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered dashboard surface, the DOM carries five labelled `role="region"` elements naming (via `aria-label` or an in-region `<h2>` header) the tile row, the chart region, the filter chrome, the timeframe picker and the export handle. A surface that omits one of the five regions either renders the region as an empty labelled `role="region"` element the pack can inspect or supersedes REQ-001 with a project-authored REQ documenting the omission.
acceptanceCriteria.then: five labelled regions cover the tile row, the chart region, the filter chrome, the timeframe picker and the export handle

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the shell's chart region, the rendered chart mounts through the application-charts render shell (TAC-1901): the chart region contains at least one `section.chartRegion[role="region"]` element carrying the shape the application-charts pack asserts on (an `svg.chartSvg` and a paired `<table>` element in the same landmark). A chart region that renders a chart outside the render shell fails project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart mounts through the application-charts render shell

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered dashboard surface, when a required region is omitted from the DOM (no export handle, no filter chrome, no timeframe picker), the surface either supersedes REQ-001 with a project-authored REQ documenting the omission (the pack looks up the sidecar `rcf/blueprints/application-dashboard.applied.json` for a `supersedes` entry) or renders the region as an empty labelled `role="region"` element the pack can inspect; a silent omission fails project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered dashboard surface with a missing region and no documented supersedes entry
acceptanceCriteria.then: the surface fails the region-count check; the applying project must either supersede REQ-001 with a documented reason or render the region as an empty labelled role=region element

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the five labelled regions, each region's accessible name is unique on the surface (a screen reader announces five distinct region names when navigating landmarks); duplicate `aria-label` values on two regions fail the pack check because the reader cannot distinguish them.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the five labelled regions on the shell
acceptanceCriteria.then: each region carries a unique accessible name; duplicates fail the pack check

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered dashboard whose chart region contains NO chart (the applying project has no charts to show), the region still renders with its `role="region"` wrapper and an accessible-name announcement; the pack accepts an empty labelled chart region and does not require a chart mount.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dashboard surface whose chart region contains no chart
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the chart region
acceptanceCriteria.then: the empty region still renders with its role=region wrapper and accessible name; the pack does not require a chart mount
